GALAXIA BLOOM 🌸

We are GALAXIA BLOOM, a team of curious minds and future explorers passionate about space, science, and innovation. We believe every great discovery begins with curiosity, creativity, and the courage to explore the unknown.

Our mission is to inspire the next generation of explorers and turn ambitious ideas into reality.

Where curiosity blooms beyond the stars.
summary:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer: Operation First Light is an immersive, story-driven educational game that transforms learning about space into an unforgettable astronaut adventure. Players step into the role of junior astronaut cadets, preparing for a fictional lunar recovery mission through 10 interactive training modules covering space science, astronaut survival, spacecraft engineering, robotics, lunar exploration, and emergency response.

Combining cinematic storytelling, realistic space concepts, interactive simulations, and mission-based challenges, our project turns complex scientific topics into engaging, accessible learning experiences. It addresses the challenge of inspiring young people to explore STEM by making space education more interactive, meaningful, and exciting.

Our vision is to spark curiosity, build scientific understanding, and inspire the next generation of explorers, scientists, and innovators.

Because every great space mission begins with curiosity.
details:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer: Operation First Light is an interactive educational space adventure where players become astronaut cadets and complete 10 training modules covering space science, astronaut survival, spacecraft engineering, lunar exploration, and emergency response.

Combining cinematic storytelling, simulations, quizzes, and interactive challenges, our project makes learning engaging and accessible. Its goal is to inspire curiosity, develop problem-solving skills, and encourage interest in STEM and space exploration.

We considered educational accuracy, accessibility, creativity, and user engagement while designing the experience. We used run.world and chatgpt prompts to bring our vision to life.
